title: Comunicado 2026-01-27
summary: The BCCh Council unanimously held the policy rate at 4.5%, pausing after the December cut. The key change versus the December communique is the guidance: the generic data-dependent line on 'the next TPM moves' is replaced by the statement that near-term inflation will be lower than forecast in December and that the Council will assess the implications of these developments for monetary policy in the March IPoM, a quiet signal that the remaining step toward neutral could come sooner. The backdrop is benign: headline and core at 3.5% and 3.3% with goods disinflation, two-year expectations anchored at 3%, an appreciating peso, higher copper and demand in line with projections, while the November Imacec contraction is judged largely transitory and employment creation remains limited. There is no explicit easing bias and the risk language is about the global scenario rather than inflation, so the communique reads as a hold with the door open to a further cut.

key_quotes.quote: La decisión fue adoptada por la unanimidad de sus miembros.
El escenario macroeconómico da cuenta de una inflación que, en el corto plazo, será menor a la prevista en diciembre, con una evolución de la demanda que ha estado en línea con lo proyectado.
key_quotes.context: Near-term inflation revised down; demand on track

key_quotes.quote: El Consejo evaluará las implicancias de estos desarrollos para la política monetaria en el IPoM de marzo.
key_quotes.context: New guidance hinting at a reassessment of the rate path in March

key_quotes.quote: En todo caso, se estima que varios de los elementos que incidieron negativamente en el desempeño del Imacec tienen un carácter transitorio.
